title: NFCPS One Read + Scripture Lens update
notes: Adds the Growth & Business discovery shelves to Read, including the bookstore-inspired titles and legal public-domain growth classics that open in the full NFCPS reader. Scripture Lens now listens to the preacher's rolling thought rather than waiting for a spoken verse reference: it semantically looks for strongly relevant Bible passages, opens the best match automatically, and cross-checks the passage in KJV, WEB and ASV. Reading progress, notes, highlights, accounts, Library and Watch remain intact.
